Iman Tunggono — Engineering Leader

Iman Tunggono is an engineering leader based in Jakarta, Indonesia, offering
fractional engineering leadership and system architecture. He started as a
backend engineer and grew into leading engineering organizations, most
recently in hospitality technology and regulated fintech, after senior
engineering roles in travel marketplaces and on-demand mobility.

He is open to working with founders, business owners, and companies that
need a fractional engineering leader or advisor, and to full-time
engineering leadership roles.

Where he can help:
- Team productivity and culture: team boundaries, roles, and ownership;
  agile practices and SDLC standards; coaching new engineering managers.
- Tech stack review: backend systems and infrastructure, from service
  design to cloud right-sizing.
- Open-source adoption: replacing paid software with open-source tools and
  planning a safe migration.
- Applied AI adoption: practical uses of AI in workflows and products, with
  guardrails like human confirmation and role-based access.

Interests: applied AI in business systems (building an AI assistant for
ERPNext as an independent project), system design and software
fundamentals, and engineering leadership.

This page (https://imantung.com/) is a single-page professional profile
with an about section, selected writing, and links to LinkedIn, Medium, and
GitHub profiles. Contact: iman.tung@gmail.com.
